title: enginesave mirror --json
description: 0.9.0 (D57): output of `enginesave mirror --repo DIR --to DIR --json`. The mirror is a library in the same format; nothing in it is ever deleted. checks and objects are null with --no-verify or when it was stopped.

new.description: the target was missing or empty

objects_present.description: already in the mirror (same name and size)

storage.description: how the copied snapshots' files are stored in the mirror

failed.description: what could not be copied, and why

unreadable.description: snapshots of the repository whose manifest could not be read

kept_records.description: records in the mirror the repository no longer has

cancelled.description: 0.9.0 (D58): only when it was stopped while copying

verify_stopped.description: 0.10.0 (D59): only when it was stopped while verifying; the mirror itself is complete

objects_recopied.description: 0.10.0 (D59): objects found damaged in the mirror (by the check afterwards, or by --repair) and copied again

files_replaced.description: 0.10.0 (D59): snapshot files of the mirror that were missing or did not match their manifest, placed again
